name: G1
requested_by: owner (chat, 2026-10-15: "test everything until you are profitable... tests on github actions")
search: gse_research/edge_search.py at the commit that adds this file: 4,836 rules over 10 families (donchian, ema_cross, rsi2, asian_breakout, drift, big_bar, gse_break, gse_sweep, prev_day, ny_open) x sides x session filter x daily-trend filter x exits
finalists: at least 50 train and 70 validation trades, expectancy > 0 and profit factor >= 1.1 in both after costs; top 10 by min(train SQN, validation SQN)

holdout.status: never used by any study before this run; loaded only by the merge step, for the finalists
holdout.pass: at least 50 trades, expectancy > 0, profit factor >= 1.2, 90% weekly-block bootstrap lower bound > 0 after a 10-way Bonferroni correction, at least 3 of 2012-2015 positive
holdout.otherwise: weak (positive but short of a criterion), fail (expectancy <= 0), inconclusive (fewer than 50 trades)

costs: OANDA bid/ask candles, 0.10 slippage on market entries, stops and market exits
after: a rule that passes goes to a forward test on live data before any trading; one that does not is not rescued by changing it and rerunning the holdout
